info.title: MiniMart api-gateway
info.description: MiniMart V1 public allowlist. Integer VND, UTC timestamps; reporting date ranges use GMT+7. Cookie actions require an allowed Origin and X-CSRF-Protection: 1. Checkout is prepare then confirm; never collect payment twice after an ambiguous response.
